repair, maintain and restore damage to the Mortgaged Property, pay Taxes and Other Charges,
and comply with Legal Requirements, in accordance with the Loan Agreement, and (ii) agrees
that the Proceeds of Insurance and Awards for Condemnation shall be settled, held and applied in
accordance with the Loan Agreement.
